# datetime.toml: dates and times: the locale's own words, the formats a body chooses
# Written by cargo test -p aralo-core --test golden. Do not edit; bless it.
# Expanded at 2026-03-09 14:05:07 +01:00. | is the caret, [] a selection.

=== a bare date and time are written the way the locale writes them
--- en_US
field: "03/09/2026 at 02:05:07 PM|"
preview: "03/09/2026 at 02:05:07 PM"
undo: 25 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "09.03.2026 at 14:05:07|"
preview: "09.03.2026 at 14:05:07"
undo: 22 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "2026年03月09日 at 14:05:07|"
preview: "2026年03月09日 at 14:05:07"
undo: 23 backspaces

=== a format the body chooses reads the same in every locale
--- en_US
field: "2026-03-09T14:05:07|"
preview: "2026-03-09T14:05:07"
undo: 19 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "2026-03-09T14:05:07|"
preview: "2026-03-09T14:05:07"
undo: 19 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "2026-03-09T14:05:07|"
preview: "2026-03-09T14:05:07"
undo: 19 backspaces

=== month and weekday names come from the locale
--- en_US
field: "Monday, 9 March 2026 (Mon Mar)|"
preview: "Monday, 9 March 2026 (Mon Mar)"
undo: 30 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "Montag, 9 März 2026 (Mo Mär)|"
preview: "Montag, 9 März 2026 (Mo Mär)"
undo: 28 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "月曜日, 9 3月 2026 (月 3月)|"
preview: "月曜日, 9 3月 2026 (月 3月)"
undo: 21 backspaces

=== a twelve-hour clock uses the locale's own am and pm
--- en_US
field: "2:05 PM / 02:05 pm|"
preview: "2:05 PM / 02:05 pm"
undo: 18 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "2:05 nachm. / 02:05 nachm.|"
preview: "2:05 nachm. / 02:05 nachm."
undo: 26 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "2:05 午後 / 02:05 午後|"
preview: "2:05 午後 / 02:05 午後"
undo: 18 backspaces

=== padding is the body's choice, not the locale's
--- en_US
field: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]|"
preview: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]"
undo: 26 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]|"
preview: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]"
undo: 26 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]|"
preview: "[09/03] [9/3] [ 9] [14:05]"
undo: 26 backspaces

=== the shorthands expand to the locale's patterns
--- en_US
field: "%c: 03/09/2026 02:05:07 PM\n%x: 03/09/2026\n%X: 02:05:07 PM\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07|"
preview: "%c: 03/09/2026 02:05:07 PM\n%x: 03/09/2026\n%X: 02:05:07 PM\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07"
undo: 84 backspaces
--- de_DE
field: "%c: 09.03.2026 14:05:07\n%x: 09.03.2026\n%X: 14:05:07\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07|"
preview: "%c: 09.03.2026 14:05:07\n%x: 09.03.2026\n%X: 14:05:07\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07"
undo: 78 backspaces
--- ja_JP
field: "%c: 2026年03月09日 14:05:07\n%x: 2026年03月09日\n%X: 14:05:07\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07|"
preview: "%c: 2026年03月09日 14:05:07\n%x: 2026年03月09日\n%X: 14:05:07\n%F %T: 2026-03-09 14:05:07"
undo: 80 backspaces

=== a locale Aralo does not carry reads in English and says so
--- en_US
field: "9 March|"
preview: "9 March"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not carry the locale xx_ZZ, so this reads in English."
--- de_DE
field: "9 March|"
preview: "9 March"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not carry the locale xx_ZZ, so this reads in English."
--- ja_JP
field: "9 March|"
preview: "9 March"
undo: 7 backspaces
note: "Aralo does not carry the locale xx_ZZ, so this reads in English."

=== a directive Aralo cannot write stays as written
--- en_US
field: "{{date: %Q}} and 14:05|"
preview: "{{date: %Q}} and 14:05"
undo: 22 backspaces
error: "Aralo cannot write %Q in a date or time. The formats it knows are in the placeholder help."
--- de_DE
field: "{{date: %Q}} and 14:05|"
preview: "{{date: %Q}} and 14:05"
